input_contract.normalization: rebuilt from the checkpoint by upstream's own inference code, not restated here
normalization_provenance: the model card states checkpoints embed their training config and inference rebuilds the model and its normalization from the checkpoint automatically
this lane therefore declares no normalization of its own; restating one would be a second copy of a fact the checkpoint already carries, free to drift from it

Measured on gpu-1 on 2026-08-23 by loading the checkpoint: the runner reports 'Configured model source=koine_machines.training.train roi_size=128 in_chans=17 preprocessing=tifxyz_robust' and selects 17 source layers. The model card's '17 of the 21 slices' describes the training jitter, not the input depth; 21 would be a claim the checkpoint itself contradicts.
input_contract.scale_note: Trained on public 2.399 um volumes pooled to ~9.6 um isotropic (level-2 XY, 4x z mean-pooling) plus 5 native 9.362 um PHerc0139 segments. A native ~9 um render runs with no resampling; a 2.4 um source must be pooled first with upstream's scripts/prepare_9um_isotropic_input.py and is not the same input.

comparability: these models train with BCE label smoothing 0.5, so the most confident no-ink output sits near 0.25 rather than 0; any screen that treats 0 as no-ink is reading a different quantity than this lane emits
the model card's display rescale (p - 0.25) / 0.5 is for viewing only and must not be applied before a quantitative read
not comparable with the 2 um or timesformer lanes: different scale, different training corpus, different no-ink floor
one checkpoint of seven along one of two seed trajectories; the model card states different steps behave differently on different segments, so a single step is not the method
measured no-ink floor on public data: p50=0.259, which is the 0.25 the model card describes; a map whose p50 is 0.000 is empty, not no-ink

non_claims: a probability map is a routing signal, not proof of ink, letters, or text
no control has been run for this lane on this corpus; it is registered so that control can be run, and asserts nothing about precision or recall here

the layer window is deliberately unpinned: upstream defaults both bounds to None and the models are z-offset sensitive, so a window belongs in a campaign's own calibrated profile rather than invented here

notes.direction: both, which emits a forward and a reverse map. The surface-normal direction that faces the ink is a measurement, and running one direction only assumes an answer this lane has no way to check.
notes.blend_mode: hann explicitly rather than upstream's 'auto', which resolves to constant without overlap and Hann otherwise. Pinning it means the receipt records the window that ran instead of a rule about which window would be chosen.
notes.checkpoint: hybrid_3d2d-seed43/step-020000.pth, 138360231 bytes. The digest was read from the upstream model repository's own LFS metadata, not asserted from a filename.
notes.pinned_source_revision: The inference entrypoint koine_machines.inference.infer is not present at the volume_cartographer source-lock commit; it lives on villa's merge-ink-pipelines branch, recorded here so the adapter's runner has an identity.
notes.compile: false. torch.compile's Inductor backend JIT-compiles kernels and needs a C compiler at run time; helena-ink-9um deliberately has none, because a compiler in a production image is attack surface that never executes. Measured on gpu-1: with compilation on, the run dies with 'InductorError: Failed to find C compiler' after the model is already resident. A deployment whose image does carry a toolchain can set this true.
notes.batch_size: 1, which is upstream's own default. The tutorial suggests 4 and this profile carried that over; measured on gpu-1 on 2026-08-23 against the model card's plain command on the public PHerc0139 w043 volume, 4 empties the map -- 0.43% non-zero at pyramid level 3, and 0.00% at full resolution after 11,006 patches and twelve minutes per direction. It exits 0 and writes a file of the right shape. --direction both and --blend-mode hann were bisected in the same run and are bit-identical to the plain command, so they stay.
notes.comparison: One checkpoint of the fourteen scrollprize/ink_9um publishes: two seeds by seven steps of a single training run. It exists as its own profile so that a run against it is comparable to a run against any other -- same recipe, same preprocessing, one declared difference. The canonical screening lane is ink-9um-hybrid-3d2d-screening@1.0.0 (seed 42, step 75000); this one is for measuring against it and is not a substitute for it.
